Top Israeli officials and media figures are going ballistic over the [U.S. and
Iran agreement ](https://zeteo.com/p/the-new-iran-peace-deal-is-a-
humiliation)to end Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu's disastrous war.

Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said the deal will cover Lebanon,
while Israeli officials insist they will continue their violence there. A U.S.
official [reportedly](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-us-trump-
peace-deal-agreed-israel/) said Israel's withdrawal from Lebanon is _not_ a
condition of the agreement, but that the deal is a "ceasefire" that all sides,
like Israel, should abide by.

While the deal - set to hopefully be signed on Friday - is technically another
temporary ceasefire to allow for further negotiations, prominent Israeli
figures, including those closest to Prime Minister Netanyahu, are incensed.

Here are nine fuming, red-in-the-face reactions from top Israeli figures,
which have ranged from attacking the U.S.-Iran deal, to defending or
castigating Netanyahu over it, to outright insulting Trump, to claiming they
don't have to abide by it:

### Itamar Ben-Gvir

Israel's controversial (and yet immovable) National Security Minister Itamar
Ben-Gvir [said](https://x.com/itamarbengvir/status/2066392115027050781?s=20)
clearly: "Trump's agreement does not bind us. Israel is not subject to the
United States, and we are an independent and sovereign nation!"

Recognizing how the U.S. subsidizes and provides cover for all of Israel's
illegality (including the settlement activity Ben-Gvir so zealously supports),
the minister did also add "We emphasize: We love the USA and are grateful to
President Trump." And yet Ben-Gvir said Israel is not party to the agreement
and would continue its attacks and violence in Lebanon, contrary to Iran's
insistence for a withdrawal from it.
